newsitem.title: USA: Campbell Soup to put hockey star Wayne Gretzky on cans.
newsitem.headline: Campbell Soup to put hockey star Wayne Gretzky on cans.

text.p: Campbell Soup Co. said Wednesday that hockey star Wayne Gretzky would become the first person ever portrayed on its cans.

The company said Gretzky's picture would appear on cans of its Chunky Soup. Campbell also said it will donate 1,000 cases of Chunky Soup to the Second Harvest Food Bank Network for every point Gretzky scores this season.
Gretzky, who now plays for the New York Rangers, holds the record as the National Hockey League's leading scorer. Last year, Gretzky scored 102 points. Points include goals and assists.
